name: Pantheon Persona Tools
description: Brokered persona agent tools: memory recall, standing-question read and proposal submission. Every call is forwarded to the Pantheon adapter broker; the plugin holds no memory or persona-service credential.

brokerUrl.description: Base URL of the adapter's internal persona-tools broker, for example http://openclaw-gateway-adapter:8104/internal/persona-tools/v1

brokerToken.description: Shared broker secret (PERSONA_TOOL_BROKER_TOKEN). Not a memory or persona-service credential.
